cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: I Started the Weirdness
cards.instruction: Hide that one casual choice caused the impossible situation while eagerly helping manage each new consequence.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: The little demon's eating the words from our crossword. I'll feed it something else; keep the lease out of reach.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It appeared when you read that novelty mug aloud.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Sequence isn't proof. Put the lease higher, please. I'll find it something less important.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It's eating the lease now. I'll copy the mug's words before we use it as bait.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: No copying. Give me the mug before we lose the lease. I'll make the exchange; you keep those remaining pages together, please.
